puntos: Keep several servers on one PC, each with its own world: accounts, characters, bans, backups and room code.
Start, Edit or Delete them from Host a server. Only one runs at a time; starting another asks to stop the current one.
Rules are chosen when you create a server and stay fixed. Your existing server keeps its data and room code.
Servers no longer have a language: the list and filters are simpler.
When hosting, choose the Duelpass points for new players (10 like the original, 100, 500 or 1000) or turn on free duels.
Manage can set or add Duelpass points and MP for each character.
Servers that stop answering show “Offline · last seen…”, and servers that went private say so.
Each language has its own rooms, like the original.
The world room still brings everyone together.
Match rooms are played as best of 3; the loser chooses who goes first.
Card thumbnails are back when activating cards, without game crashes.
